note: Reference model registry. Costs and context sizes are placeholders to be set from the vendor's current published figures at deployment time. approved_trust_domains is the governance-critical field: it constrains where content may be SENT, independently of what a user is entitled to READ.

models.notes: Default generation model for the district knowledge assistant. Not approved for personnel or student-confidential content; a use case needing those must route to llm-sensitive after its own review.
Requires a signed data protection addendum and confirmed no-training terms before a district enables it.
Preview lifecycle. Per ADR-006 this model cannot be selected by default routing; a caller must pass allow_preview explicitly and the use case must record the preview dependency.
